senses.def: to go to an event such as a meeting or a wedding
senses.ex: More than two hundred people attended the meeting.
senses.exPt: Mais de duzentas pessoas participaram da reunião.

senses.def: to go regularly to a school, college or church
senses.ex: Both of our children attend the local school.
senses.exPt: Nossos dois filhos frequentam a escola do bairro.

senses.def: the fact of being present at a place, such as school or work
senses.ex: Attendance at all the classes is compulsory.
senses.exPt: A presença em todas as aulas é obrigatória.

senses.def: the number of people who go to an event
senses.ex: Attendance at the concert was lower than expected.
senses.exPt: O público do show foi menor do que o esperado.

senses.def: the act of listening, looking at or thinking about something carefully
senses.ex: Please pay attention to the teacher.
senses.exPt: Por favor, prestem atenção na professora.

senses.def: listening or watching carefully
senses.ex: The students were very attentive during the lesson.
senses.exPt: Os alunos ficaram muito atentos durante a aula.

senses.def: helpful and caring about other people's needs
senses.ex: The hotel staff were friendly and attentive.
senses.exPt: Os funcionários do hotel eram simpáticos e atenciosos.

senses.def: while listening or watching carefully
senses.ex: The students listened attentively to the speaker.
senses.exPt: Os alunos ouviram o palestrante com atenção.

senses.def: the way you think and feel about something
senses.ex: She has a very positive attitude to life.
senses.exPt: Ela tem uma atitude muito positiva diante da vida.

senses.def: to make people come to a place or be interested in something
senses.ex: The festival attracts thousands of visitors every year.
senses.exPt: O festival atrai milhares de visitantes todo ano.

senses.def: a place people visit for pleasure, or a feeling of liking someone
senses.ex: The castle is the city's main tourist attraction.
senses.exPt: O castelo é a principal atração turística da cidade.

senses.def: pleasant to look at, or interesting and wanted
senses.ex: They made me a very attractive job offer.
senses.exPt: Eles me fizeram uma oferta de emprego muito atraente.

senses.def: the quality of being pleasant to look at or interesting
senses.ex: The beaches add to the city's attractiveness for tourists.
senses.exPt: As praias aumentam a atratividade da cidade para os turistas.

senses.def: a quality or feature of a person or thing
senses.ex: Patience is an important attribute for a teacher.
senses.exPt: A paciência é uma qualidade importante para um professor.

senses.def: to say that something is caused by or belongs to someone or something
senses.ex: She attributes her success to hard work.
senses.exPt: Ela atribui o seu sucesso ao trabalho duro.

senses.def: not usual or typical
senses.ex: This cold weather is atypical for this time of year.
senses.exPt: Esse frio é atípico para esta época do ano.

senses.def: a large vegetable with dark purple skin
senses.ex: I'm making a pasta sauce with aubergine and tomatoes.
senses.exPt: Estou fazendo um molho de macarrão com berinjela e tomate.

senses.def: the people watching or listening to a show, film or talk
senses.ex: The audience clapped at the end of the show.
senses.exPt: A plateia aplaudiu no final do show.

senses.def: connected with recording or playing sound
senses.ex: The teacher played an audio recording in class.
senses.exPt: A professora tocou uma gravação de áudio na aula.

senses.def: an official check of a company's financial records
senses.ex: The company is having its annual audit next month.
senses.exPt: A empresa vai passar pela auditoria anual no mês que vem.

senses.def: a short performance to show if you are good enough for a role
senses.ex: She has an audition for the school play tomorrow.
senses.exPt: Ela tem um teste para a peça da escola amanhã.

senses.def: the eighth month of the year
senses.ex: We always go to the beach in August.
senses.exPt: A gente sempre vai à praia em agosto.

senses.def: the sister of your mother or father, or your uncle's wife
senses.ex: My aunt sends me a card every birthday.
senses.exPt: Minha tia me manda um cartão todo aniversário.

senses.def: a person who writes a book or article
senses.ex: Who is the author of this book?
senses.exPt: Quem é o autor deste livro?

senses.def: respected and trusted as being correct
senses.ex: This book is an authoritative guide to European birds.
senses.exPt: Este livro é um guia de referência sobre as aves da Europa.

senses.def: showing that you expect to be obeyed and respected
senses.ex: The teacher spoke in a calm but authoritative voice.
senses.exPt: A professora falou com uma voz calma, mas firme.

senses.def: the power to give orders, or an official group that has this power
senses.ex: The local authorities closed the road after the storm.
senses.exPt: As autoridades locais fecharam a estrada depois da tempestade.

senses.def: to give official permission for something
senses.ex: Only the manager can authorize a refund.
senses.exPt: Só o gerente pode autorizar um reembolso.

senses.def: working by itself without a person controlling it
senses.ex: The doors are automatic, so they open by themselves.
senses.exPt: As portas são automáticas, então abrem sozinhas.

senses.def: by itself, without a person controlling it
senses.ex: The door opens automatically.
senses.exPt: A porta abre automaticamente.

senses.def: the season between summer and winter
senses.ex: The leaves turn yellow and red in autumn.
senses.exPt: As folhas ficam amarelas e vermelhas no outono.

senses.def: giving extra help or support
senses.ex: In English, do is often used as an auxiliary verb.
senses.exPt: Em inglês, do é muitas vezes usado como verbo auxiliar.

senses.def: the fact that something can be bought, used or reached
senses.ex: Please check the availability of rooms before you book your flight.
senses.exPt: Por favor, confira a disponibilidade de quartos antes de comprar a passagem.

senses.def: that you can get, buy or use; free to do something
senses.ex: Tickets for the concert are available online.
senses.exPt: Os ingressos para o show estão disponíveis online.

senses.def: a wide street in a town or city, often with trees
senses.ex: We live on a quiet avenue lined with trees.
senses.exPt: Moramos em uma avenida tranquila cheia de árvores.

senses.def: found by adding numbers together and dividing by how many there are
senses.ex: The average age of the students is twenty.
senses.exPt: A idade média dos alunos é vinte anos.

senses.def: ordinary; not special
senses.ex: He's just an average guy with a normal job.
senses.exPt: Ele é só um cara comum com um emprego normal.

senses.def: the usual or typical amount or level
senses.ex: My marks this year are above average.
senses.exPt: Minhas notas este ano estão acima da média.

senses.def: very keen and enthusiastic about something you do often
senses.ex: My grandfather is an avid reader of detective novels.
senses.exPt: Meu avô é um leitor voraz de romances policiais.

senses.def: to stay away from someone or something, or try not to do something
senses.ex: Try to avoid eating too much sugar.
senses.exPt: Tente evitar comer açúcar demais.

senses.def: to wait for something
senses.ex: We are still awaiting the results of the test.
senses.exPt: Ainda estamos aguardando os resultados do exame.

senses.def: not sleeping
senses.ex: Are you still awake? It's very late.
senses.exPt: Você ainda está acordado? Já está muito tarde.

senses.def: a prize given to someone for something they have done
senses.ex: She won an award for her first film.
senses.exPt: Ela ganhou um prêmio pelo primeiro filme dela.

senses.def: knowing that something exists or is happening
senses.ex: Are you aware of the risks of this job?
senses.exPt: Você está ciente dos riscos desse trabalho?

senses.def: knowing about something or understanding that it exists
senses.ex: There is growing awareness of the dangers of smoking.
senses.exPt: Há uma consciência cada vez maior dos perigos do cigarro.

senses.def: at or to a distance from a place or person
senses.ex: Please stay away from the fire.
senses.exPt: Por favor, fique longe do fogo.

senses.def: not at home or at work for a time
senses.ex: My boss is away until next Monday.
senses.exPt: Meu chefe está fora até a próxima segunda.

senses.def: a feeling of great respect mixed with wonder or fear
senses.ex: We stood in awe as we looked at the huge waterfall.
senses.exPt: Ficamos olhando a enorme cachoeira, cheios de admiração.

senses.def: very good or impressive
senses.ex: The concert last night was awesome!
senses.exPt: O show de ontem à noite foi incrível!

senses.def: very bad or unpleasant
senses.ex: The food at the hotel was awful.
senses.exPt: A comida do hotel era horrível.

senses.def: making you feel embarrassed or uncomfortable
senses.ex: There was an awkward silence after his joke.
senses.exPt: Houve um silêncio constrangedor depois da piada dele.

senses.def: feeling shy or not relaxed with other people
senses.ex: I always feel a bit awkward at parties.
senses.exPt: Sempre me sinto meio sem jeito em festas.

senses.def: a tool with a heavy metal blade and a long handle, for cutting wood
senses.ex: He chopped the wood with an ax.
senses.exPt: Ele cortou a lenha com um machado.

senses.def: an imaginary line through the middle of something that turns, or a line on a graph
senses.ex: The Earth turns on its axis once every 24 hours.
senses.exPt: A Terra gira em torno do seu eixo uma vez a cada 24 horas.
